The Startup Ideas Podcast (SIP)
Boris Cherny, the creator of Claude Code, shared his entire setup.
Claude Code 的创建者鲍里斯·切尔尼分享了他的整个配置。

He runs 5-10 Claudes in parallel. Half his coding happens from his phone.
他并行运行 5-10 个 Claudes。他一半的编码工作是在手机上完成的。

Here's his 3-part formula for better results:
这是他为获得更好结果的三部分方法：

Use the smartest model available
— Counterintuitive: it's actually cheaper
— Smarter model = fewer tokens = lower total cost
— "Once the plan is good, the code is good"
使用最智能的可用模型
— 反直觉的：实际上更便宜
— 更智能的模型 = 更少的 tokens = 更低的总成本
一旦计划好，代码就好

Invest in your Claude MD
— Plain text file. No special format.
— Whole team contributes multiple times a week
— Every mistake Claude makes gets added so it never happens again
投资于你的 Claude MD
— 纯文本文件。无特殊格式。
— 整个团队每周多次贡献
Claude 犯的每一个错误都会被记录下来，以便它再也不会发生

Give Claude a way to verify its own output
— Let it run the code. Let it see the browser.
— "Imagine you're a painter wearing a blindfold"
— Same thing for an AI that can never check its work
给 Claude 一种验证它自己输出的方式
— 让它运行代码。让它看到浏览器。
想象你是一名戴着眼罩的画家
—— 对于一个永远无法检查自身工作的人工智能也是如此

His morning routine: wake up, kick off 3 sessions from his phone, check in later.
他的晨间例行活动：醒来，从手机上启动3个会话，稍后签到。

His workflow: start in plan mode
→ lock the plan
→ auto-accept edits
→ done.
他的工作流程：开始于计划模式
→ 锁定计划
→ 自动接受编辑
→ 完成

No fancy setup.
没有复杂的设置。

No complex tooling.
无需复杂工具。

Just multiple Claudes, a good plan, and a shared knowledge base.
只需多个 Claude、一个好计划和一个共享的知识库。

热门回复

@The Startup Ideas Podcast (SIP) ♥ 12 · 💬 0

it was a banger

checkout the full ep:
这简直太棒了！

查看完整剧集:

@Jason Haugh ♥ 4 · 💬 2

I run 8 Claude agents in parallel every day. The 'use the smartest model' advice is real. I switched my core agents to Opus and the error rate dropped enough that it paid for itself in time saved.
我每天并行运行 8 个 Claude 代理。“使用最智能模型”的建议是真实有效的。我将核心代理切换到 Opus 模型后，错误率下降，节省的时间足以让这个切换实现了成本回收。

@Vaclav Milizé ♥ 5 · 💬 1

the buried line is "wake up, kick off 3 sessions from his phone." that's the real shift: he turned coding from a synchronous activity into an asynchronous delegation loop. most devs think "parallel Claude" means multiple terminal windows. Boris is describing something different:
潜台词是“醒来，从手机上开启 3 个会话。”这才是真正的转变：他把编码从一种同步活动变成了一种异步委托循环。大多数开发者认为“并行 Claude”指的是多个终端窗口。而鲍里斯描述的是完全不同的东西：

@tom howard ♥ 1 · 💬 2

looks like a good episode.
看起来是个好的一集。

@Snapper AI ♥ 3 · 💬 0

Video here on how to set it up:
这里有关于如何设置的视频
